content: {"praised":["Fanny Ardant delivers a powerful, emotionally rich performance.","The film pays respectful tribute to Maria Callas.","Lip‑synced singing captures Callas’s iconic vocal power.","Visuals evoke 1970s Parisian elegance.","Music selection highlights Callas’s legendary repertoire."],"criticized":["Opening with rock music feels jarring and out of place.","Gay subplot irrelevant to Callas’s story.","Story is muddled and confusing.","Pacing suffers; only last 30 minutes improve.","Film’s technology and special effects appear unrealistic."]}
